notes.title: T -24 Days Until Official Release
notes.notes:
Flight 732 is ready.  Testing continues and minor improvements to increase the player's experience are being worked on.  Early release is being considered for this title.  If you are interested, please leave a comment or Rate-Up this announcement.  Those will be considered in the decision to release early.  Thanks to those who have followed us this far!
web:  www.gheregames.com
Twitter:  @gheregames
